expected_segments: Your goal: Anticipate the needs of different road users without assuming that everyone sees, hears or moves as you do.

checks.name: M05-L01/teaching-002 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Requirements. Show particular consideration for children, older people, school patrols and people whose disability or illness is apparent and affects their use of traffic. Reduce speed appropriately near children, stopped passenger transport and other situations with foreseeable risks. Give pedestrians sufficient room and time when meeting or passing them. Traffic Regulation, chapter 2 §1 and chapter 3 §§15 and 58

Allow time and observe their movement rather than demanding a response through the horn.
